title_en: Delaware-based Causa Prima, which develops an agent-to-agent AI platform for managing B2B payments, resolving billing disputes, and more, raised a $20M seed (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
author: Fortune
content_snippet:
On Tuesday, Delaware-based Causa Prima announced a $20 million seed round that closed in September to expand its agent-to-agent platform, which resolves billing disputes and speeds up payment times between companies and their suppliers. Cofounded by German entrepreneurs Maex Ament, Henrik Gebbing, and Philip Stanislaus, the company previously raised $10 million in a pre-seed round, bringing its total funding to $30 million.

“The status quo today is that a lot of things are still somewhat manual
summary_en: Delaware-based fintech startup Causa Prima announced a $20 million seed round led by Base10 Partners, bringing its total funding to $30 million. The company is developing an agent-to-agent AI platform designed to automate interactions between companies' accounts payable and their suppliers' accounts receivable systems. By addressing the manual bottlenecks and billing dispute delays that occur across corporate boundaries rather than just internally, the platform aims to significantly streamline enterprise settlement workflows.

title: 微软单月修补超1400个漏洞创历史新高
title_en: Microsoft releases updates fixing 1,400+ security vulnerabilities, surpassing September's record of 972, which was already ~10x the normal monthly patch load (Brian Krebs/Krebs on Security)
author: Krebs on Security
content_snippet:
Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

Just one of the weaknesses patched this week is considered a “zero day,” or already exploited in the wild. CVE-2026-96951 is a security feature bypass in the Windows Shell that affects Windows 10 and 11 systems, as
summary_en: Microsoft released a massive security update addressing over 1,400 vulnerabilities across its Windows operating systems and software stack, shattering the prior record of 972 fixes and exceeding typical monthly loads by roughly tenfold. The batch includes 78 critical remote code execution flaws and one zero-day vulnerability in the Windows Shell actively exploited in the wild, prompting Redmond to quietly extend Windows 10 support further out to October 2027.

【起因与机理】系统遗留代码复杂度剧增、攻击面扩大，以及企业用户难以在短期内完成新系统迁移

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Compounding legacy code vulnerabilities and user resistance to migrating off Windows 10
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Microsoft patches over 1,400 flaws in a historic single-month security update.
[Key Position & Outlook] Windows 10 free update support quietly pushed back to October 2027.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软在最新的安全更新中一次性修复了操作系统及核心软件中超过1400个安全漏洞，不仅直接打破了此前972个的月度历史纪录，更达到常规补丁体量的十几倍。本次更新涵盖78个可能导致远程代码执行的“严重”级别缺陷，并紧急封堵了一起涉及Windows Shell绕过的在野零日漏洞。面对庞大的企业升级阻力与持续暴露的底层架构隐患，微软同时被迫将Windows 10的免费安全支持周期再度顺延至2027年10月。
